_note: Flavors, heat (0 to 5), descriptions and bag prices for the whole site. Edited in Fixx Studio. Leave photo blank to use /img/flavors/<flavor-slug>.webp.

flavors.name: X-Hot Green
flavors.description: Our hottest green chile jerky. Green chile heat stacked on more green chile for the fiends who like it loud.

flavors.name: Green
flavors.description: Classic New Mexico green chile carne seca. Earthy, bright and just the right burn.

flavors.name: Red
flavors.description: Red chile beef jerky with deep, smoky New Mexico red chile flavor.

flavors.name: X-Mas
flavors.description: Can't choose? Red and green chile together, Christmas style, the way New Mexico does it.

flavors.name: Lemon Pepper Green
flavors.description: Zesty lemon pepper meets green chile heat. Bright, peppery and hard to put down.

flavors.name: Garlic Parm Green
flavors.description: Savory garlic and parmesan with a green chile kick.

flavors.name: Green Chili Ranch
flavors.description: Cool ranch seasoning with a mellow green chile warmth.

flavors.name: Honey Teriyaki Green
flavors.description: Sweet honey teriyaki with a little green chile bite on the finish.

flavors.name: Mango Habanero
flavors.description: Sweet mango up front, slow habanero burn on the way out.

flavors.name: Asian Zing
flavors.description: Savory, tangy and a little sweet with an Asian inspired zing.

flavors.name: Takis
flavors.description: Rolled chile lime crunch flavor on thin cut carne seca. Sour, spicy and gone way too fast.

flavors.name: Hot Cheetos
flavors.description: Red hot cheeto dust packed into every strip. Your fingers will be red and you won't care.

flavors.name: Hot Mamma
flavors.description: A hot one for the heat chasers. Bold red chile spice with a serious kick.

flavors.name: Hot Mamma Cheeto
flavors.description: Hot Mamma heat plus hot cheeto dust. Double trouble for spice fiends.

flavors.name: Hot Cheeto Pickle
flavors.description: Dill pickle tang meets hot cheeto heat. It sounds wild. It sells out anyway.

flavors.name: Salt
flavors.description: Simple, beefy and clean. Just meat and salt for the purists.

flavors.name: Salt x Pepper
flavors.description: The classic pair. Salt and cracked black pepper on thin cut beef.

flavors.name: X-Hot Green Chili Lime Salt
flavors.description: X-Hot green chile with lime and a hit of salt. Tangy, salty, very hot.

flavors.name: Lemon Pepper
flavors.description: Bright lemon and cracked black pepper. A classic that never gets old.

flavors.name: Garlic
flavors.description: Garlic lovers only. Big savory garlic flavor with zero heat.

flavors.name: Garlic Parm
flavors.description: Roasted garlic and nutty parmesan. Mellow on the heat, loud on the flavor.

flavors.name: Teriyaki
flavors.description: Savory teriyaki glaze on tender, thin cut beef.

flavors.name: Honey Teriyaki
flavors.description: Sweet, sticky and savory. The gateway flavor for the kids and the grandmas.

flavors.name: Pickle
flavors.description: Tangy dill pickle jerky. Sour, salty and weirdly addictive.

flavors.name: Tajin Limon
flavors.description: Chile lime Tajin style seasoning with a bright limon finish.
